summary: Lower Function.prototype.call through JS call semantics when the builtin method is proven unmodified.

target.notes: call checks callability then invokes with the provided thisArg and remaining arguments. The target's strict/sloppy/lexical this mode determines how thisArg is used.

semantics.arrow_or_bound: their own call semantics may ignore supplied thisArg

caveats: A property named call may be overridden on the function or prototype chain.

tests.name: arrow ignores thisArg
tests.expected_behavior: prints true in the same enclosing this context
